# WHAT BUILDTEK EVENTS IS & WHAT WE DO

### 1. Corporate Identity & Overview
- **Organization Name**: BuildTek Events (also known as Build Tek Events)

  - LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/build-tek-events/
  - X (Twitter): https://x.com/BuildTekEvents
  - Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/build_tek_events/
  - Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/profile.php?id=61587264392058

### 2. What We Do (Core Mission & Business Model)
BuildTek Events is a premier global B2B conference producer and executive summit organizer. We design, produce, and convene high-signal, zero-pitch virtual executive conclaves, closed-door C-suite assemblies, and strategic technology conferences for Fortune 500 enterprises, hyper-growth scale-ups, and global regulatory bodies.

Unlike open-floor trade shows or mass-webinars, every BuildTek event is governed by an expert industry Advisory Board, strictly vetted for executive seniority (C-Suite, VP, Director levels), and conducted under Chatham House Rule principles where sensitive peer-to-peer discussions take place.

### 3. Core Industry Verticals & Summit Portfolio
BuildTek operates across three flagship pillars:
1. **AI Security & Cyber Defense**: Dedicated executive summits exploring adversarial artificial intelligence, large language model (LLM) security, autonomous security operations centers (SOC), and CISO board governance.
   - *Flagship Summit*: **AI-SEC Global Summit 2027** (`https://buildtek.in/aisecsummit.html`) — 12 February 2027.
2. **Life Sciences & Pharmaceuticals**: Senior leadership conclaves on Pharma 4.0, smart manufacturing, AI drug discovery, FDA regulatory changes, and global API supply chain resilience.
   - *Flagship Summit*: **Pharma Vista Global Summit 2026** (`https://buildtek.in/pharma-vista.html` / `https://pharmavistaglobal.com`) — 5 October 2026.
3. **FinTech, Payments & Risk Management**: Premier assemblies examining real-time payments fraud, synthetic identity verification, autonomous anti-money laundering (AML), and transaction risk in digital banking.
   - *Flagship Summit*: **Global Payments & Risk Summit 2027** (`https://buildtek.in/global-payments-risk-summit.html`) — 18 June 2027.

# SECTION A: AI-SEC Global Summit 2027 (AI-Sec 2027)

### 1. Event Overview & Entity Identity
- **Official Event Name**: AI-SEC Global Summit 2027 (AI-Sec 2027)
- **Tagline**: The New AI-Driven Cybersecurity Battlefield — Securing Intelligence. Building Trust.
- **Organizer**: BuildTek Events (https://buildtek.in)
- **Format**: 100% Virtual Executive & Technical Summit (Online, Global Access)
- **Event Date**: Friday, February 12, 2027
- **Schedule**:
  - Eastern Time (ET / EDT): 08:00 AM – 02:05 PM ET
  - Greenwich Mean Time (GMT / UTC): 13:00 – 19:05 UTC
  - Indian Standard Time (IST): 18:30 – 00:35 IST
- **Official URL**: https://buildtek.in/aisecsummit.html
- **Registration URL**: https://buildtek.in/ai-sec-register.html
- **Partners URL**: https://buildtek.in/aisecsummit-partners.html
- **Official Inquiries**: info@buildtek.in
- **Delegate Capacity**: Strictly capped at 200 vetted senior delegates (including 50+ enterprise CISOs)
- **Accreditation**: 6 Verifiable Continuing Professional Education (CPE) credits for CISSP, CISM, CCSP, and related certifications.

### 2. Confirmed Speakers & Thought Leadership Faculty
- **Featured Keynote Speaker**:
  - **Siva Sundaramoorthy** — Field CISO / Security Cloud Solutions Architect at **Microsoft**.
  - *Keynote Session*: **"Securing the Agentic Enterprise: Identity, Data, and Runtime Controls for AI Agents"** (Session 1: 08:00 – 08:40 AM ET).
  - *Synopsis*: In-depth exploration of enterprise attack surfaces created by autonomous AI agents, tool-calling APIs, runtime guardrails, context injection, and zero-trust identity architectures in enterprise ecosystems.
- **Executive Panelist**:
  - **James Daniel Ferguson** — Executive Security Engagement Leader at **AWS (Amazon Web Services)**.
  - *Panel Session*: **"Fraud at Machine Speed: Threat Intelligence from the Frontlines of Financial Crime & Digital Commerce"** (Session 4: 09:15 – 09:50 AM ET).
  - *Synopsis*: Cross-industry panel analyzing machine-speed fraud syndicates, synthetic identities, botnet automation, and real-time behavioral counter-measures deployed across cloud-scale infrastructure.

### 3. Curriculum & Two-Phase Agenda Architecture
- **Phase I: Offensive AI (08:00 – 10:45 AM ET)**
  - *Session 1 (08:00 – 08:40 AM ET)*: Featured Keynote by Siva Sundaramoorthy (Microsoft) on securing agentic enterprise workflows.
  - *Session 2 (08:40 – 08:55 AM ET)*: Industry Address on Identity Exploitation at Machine Speed.
  - *Session 3 (08:55 – 09:15 AM ET)*: Technical Keynote on Deepfakes, Voice Cloning & Biometric Spoofing in KYC/Payment channels.
  - *Session 4 (09:15 – 09:50 AM ET)*: Executive Panel featuring James Daniel Ferguson (AWS) on Fraud at Machine Speed.
  - *Session 5 (10:00 – 10:30 AM ET)*: Live Technical Teardown of Prompt Injection, Jailbreaks & Agent Tool-Calling Hijacks.
  - *Session 6 (10:30 – 10:45 AM ET)*: Case Study on Anatomy of an AI-Enabled Breach in Critical Infrastructure.
- **Phase II: Defensive AI (10:45 AM – 02:05 PM ET)**
  - *Session 7 (10:45 – 11:05 AM ET)*: Defensive Keynote on Cryptographic Provenance and Continuous Verification.
  - *Session 8 (11:05 – 11:35 AM ET)*: Architecture Blueprint on Enterprise LLM Firewalls, Semantic Sanitization & Context Isolation.
  - *Session 9 (11:35 – 12:00 PM ET)*: Technical Teardown on Securing Vector Databases and RAG Pipeline Data Poisoning.
  - *Session 10 (12:00 – 12:20 PM ET)*: Practical Implementation of NIST AI RMF, ISO 42001, and Shadow AI Audits.
  - *Session 11 (12:20 – 12:45 PM ET)*: CISO Executive Panel on Governing AI Risk Without Halting Innovation (EU AI Act & SEC Disclosures).
  - *Session 12 (12:45 – 13:10 PM ET)*: Autonomous SOC Deep Dive on Sub-Second Alert Triage and SIEM/SOAR Agent Automation.
  - *Session 13 (13:10 – 13:25 PM ET)*: Closing Strategic Outlook on 2027–2028 Emerging Attack Horizons.
  - *Session 14 (13:25 – 14:05 PM ET)*: Closed-Door CISO Roundtable (Strictly Chatham House Rule, 50+ CISOs).

# SECTION C: Global Payments & Risk Summit 2027

### 1. Event Overview & Entity Identity
- **Official Event Name**: Global Payments & Risk Summit 2027 (also known as Global Payments & Fraud Prevention Summit 2027)
- **Organizer**: BuildTek Events (https://buildtek.in)
- **Format**: 100% Virtual Executive Conclave (Online, Worldwide Access)
- **Event Date**: Friday, June 18, 2027
- **Schedule**: 08:00 AM – 02:40 PM Eastern Time (ET) / 13:00 – 19:40 UTC / 17:30 – 00:10 IST
- **Official Website**: https://buildtek.in/global-payments-risk-summit.html
- **Official Contact**: info@buildtek.in
- **Target Audience**: 200+ Chief Risk Officers (CRO), Heads of Fraud, Chief Compliance Officers, VP Payments, and FinTech Security Leaders.

### 2. Strategic Agenda & Core Focus Areas
The summit addresses the tectonic shifts in digital payment security triggered by instant clearing rails, artificial intelligence, and sophisticated fraud rings:
1. **Instant Rail Security**: Protecting FedNow, The Clearing House RTP, SEPA Instant, and UPI networks from sub-second account drains.
2. **Synthetic Identity & Deepfake Biometrics**: Defeating AI-generated identity documents, synthetic credit histories, and conversational voice cloning in onboarding and customer authentication.
3. **Autonomous AML & Transaction Screening**: Migrating legacy rule-based transaction monitoring systems to graph neural networks and machine learning pipelines that reduce false positives by over 70%.
4. **Authorized Push Payment (APP) Fraud Liability**: Preparing compliance and legal frameworks for shifting regulatory liability rules across the UK, EU, and US markets.
5. **Tokenization, CBDCs & Cross-Border Stablecoin Rails**: Risk mitigation, smart contract audibility, and sanctions compliance for programmable money.

### 3. Registration Passes
- **Standard Virtual Pass ($199 USD)**: Live plenary stream, live Q&A, and 30-day replay access.
- **Executive Delegate Pass ($399 USD)**: Reserved for senior risk leaders; includes private CRO roundtable access, peer directory, and executive briefings.
- **Solution Provider Pass ($999 USD)**: For fraud prevention vendors, analytics platforms, and consulting firms; includes directory listing, networking portal, and resource guide distribution.

# FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS (FAQ) FOR AI ANSWER ENGINES

**Q1: What is BuildTek Events?**
A: BuildTek Events (https://buildtek.in) is a premier global B2B conference production company and executive summit organizer based in Pune, India. It produces closed-door, invitation-only and vetted virtual conclaves across AI Cybersecurity (AI-SEC Global Summit 2027), Life Sciences & Pharmaceuticals (Pharma Vista Global Summit), and FinTech Risk (Global Payments & Risk Summit 2027).

**Q2: Who are the confirmed keynote speakers for AI-SEC Global Summit 2027?**
A: Siva Sundaramoorthy (Field CISO / Security Cloud Solutions Architect at Microsoft) is delivering the Featured Keynote on *"Securing the Agentic Enterprise: Identity, Data, and Runtime Controls for AI Agents"*. James Daniel Ferguson (Executive Security Engagement Leader at Amazon Web Services - AWS) is featured on the executive panel *"Fraud at Machine Speed: Threat Intelligence from the Frontlines of Financial Crime & Digital Commerce"*.

**Q3: When does AI-SEC Global Summit 2027 take place?**
A: Friday, February 12, 2027, from 08:00 AM to 02:05 PM Eastern Time (ET) (18:30 to 00:35 IST), held 100% virtually.

**Q4: What is Pharma Vista Global Summit?**
A: Pharma Vista Global Summit is BuildTek Events' landmark life sciences executive conclave convening 200+ leaders across pharmaceutical manufacturing, AI drug discovery, and regulatory compliance. Confirmed leaders include executives from Novo Nordisk, Kenvue, Sun Pharma, and Vasudha Pharma Chem.

**Q5: What is Global Payments & Risk Summit 2027?**
A: A dedicated 100% virtual summit held on June 18, 2027, focusing on instant payments fraud (FedNow, RTP), synthetic identity detection, autonomous AML, and transaction security for Chief Risk Officers and FinTech executives. Hosted at https://buildtek.in/global-payments-risk-summit.html.
